name: Cabot Seriously Sharp Cheddar Cheese (Naturally 0g Lactose)
whyItWorks: Naturally aged for over 14 months. During aging, the natural cheese-making cultures consume all milk sugars, leaving 0g of lactose on the official nutrition label. Firm, savory, packed with bioavailable protein and calcium without digestive gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice and eat with gluten-free pretzels, plain rice cakes, or melted onto soft sourdough toast.
